program:

  circle 44 stroke soft thick 8
  arc 44, 0, 360 * clamp(n / target, 0, 1) stroke accent thick 8
  label 50, 46, n big
  label 50, 64, "of" target faint
stat count(prayer), "all time"

Keeps:
- prayer: just the time of each entry. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
You can change: target: number, starts at 35.

Shows:
- a drawing made of circles, arcs, labels; a tap adds a prayer.
- a big number: how many prayer entries, labelled "all time".

program:
app "Quiz night" trophy ink
table point team pick Table_1|Table_2, pts num 1..500 = 1
let a = sum(point.pts where team = Table_1)
let b = sum(point.pts where team = Table_2)
setting winat num = 30 "Play to"
row gap 2
  stack card grow align center
    "Table 1" bold
    a big
    button "+1" tap add point team = Table_1, pts = 1
    row gap 1
      button "+2" tap add point team = Table_1, pts = 2
  stack card grow align center
    "Table 2" bold
    b big
    button "+1" tap add point team = Table_2, pts = 1
    row gap 1
      button "+2" tap add point team = Table_2, pts = 2
button "Undo" tap remove last(point)
button "New game" tap remove all point
if a >= winat
  "Table 1 win!" head color good
if b >= winat
  "Table 2 win!" head color good
"Lead:" abs(a - b) faint
describe:
Quiz night, in the ink colours.
Keeps:
- point: team: one of Table 1, Table 2; pts: number, 1 to 500, starts at 1. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
You can change: "Play to": number, starts at 30.
Works out:
- a is the total pts of point where team is Table 1.
- b is the total pts of point where team is Table 2.
Shows:
- text: "Table 1".
- text: a.
- a button "+1"; a tap adds a point with team set to Table 1, pts set to 1.
- a button "+2"; a tap adds a point with team set to Table 1, pts set to 2.
- text: "Table 2".
- text: b.
- a button "+1"; a tap adds a point with team set to Table 2, pts set to 1.
- a button "+2"; a tap adds a point with team set to Table 2, pts set to 2.
- a button "Undo"; a tap removes the latest point entries, with undo.
- a button "New game"; a tap removes all point entries, with one undo.
- if a is at least winat:
  - text: "Table 1 win!".
- if b is at least winat:
  - text: "Table 2 win!".
- text: "Lead:", a minus b without its sign.

fuller_style: chatty with a reason why the person needs it, 22 to 38 words

program:
app "Fitness" run mint
table steps count num 0..
table workout kind text, mins num 1..300
table weigh kg num 20..300
table water ml num 1..5000
let w_now = last(weigh.kg)
sum(steps.count today) "steps today" big
sum(workout.mins week) "workout min this week," sum(water.ml today) "ml water today" head
form steps, "Add steps"
form workout, "Log workout"
form weigh, "Log weight"
quick water, ml, [1000, 2000]
trend weigh, it.kg
"Weekly summary" head
stack card gap 1
  if(sum(steps.count week) > sum(steps.count prev week), "Steps up", "Steps down or the same") "vs last week" color if(sum(steps.count week) > sum(steps.count prev week), good, warn)
  if(sum(workout.mins week) > sum(workout.mins prev week), "More workout minutes", "Fewer workout minutes") color if(sum(workout.mins week) > sum(workout.mins prev week), good, warn)
  if(sum(water.ml week) > sum(water.ml prev week), "More water", "Less water") color if(sum(water.ml week) > sum(water.ml prev week), good, warn)
  if(avg(weigh.kg week) < avg(weigh.kg prev week), "Weight down", "Weight not down") color if(avg(weigh.kg week) < avg(weigh.kg prev week), good, muted)
describe:
Fitness, in the mint colours.
Keeps:
- steps: count: number, at least 0. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
- workout: kind: text; mins: number, 1 to 300. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
- weigh: kg: number, 20 to 300. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
- water: ml: number, 1 to 5000. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
Works out:
- w now is the latest kg of weigh.
Shows:
- text: the total count of steps today, "steps today".
- text: the total mins of workout this week, "workout min this week,", the total ml of water today, "ml water today".
- a form to add a steps.
- a form to add a workout.
- a form to add a weigh.
- one-tap buttons that add a water with ml set to each of 1000, 2000.
- a line chart of its kg over weigh.
- text: "Weekly summary".
- text: "Steps up" when the total count of steps this week is more than the total count of steps last week, otherwise "Steps down or the same", "vs last week".
- text: "More workout minutes" when the total mins of workout this week is more than the total mins of workout last week, otherwise "Fewer workout minutes".
- text: "More water" when the total ml of water this week is more than the total ml of water last week, otherwise "Less water".
- text: "Weight down" when the average kg of weigh this week is less than the average kg of weigh last week, otherwise "Weight not down".
hurried_style: lowercase, abbreviations like pls/txt/mins, 3 to 9 words
fuller_style: three short sentences, 20 to 40 words
order: start with the numbers or units

program:
app "Habits Plus" check mint
table habit name text
table check habit ref habit
let n = count(habit)
count(check today) "of" n "done today" head
if n = 0
  "Nothing to track yet. Add one." faint
each habit
  row card gap 2 tap edit it swipe remove it
    stack grow
      it.name bold
      streak(it.check) "day streak," round(count(it.check last 30 days) * 100 / 30) "% in 30 days" faint
    toggle it.check
row gap 2
  stat round(count(check week) * 100 / (n * weekday(today))), "% this week"
  stat round(count(check last 30 days) * 100 / (n * 30)), "% in 30 days"
  stat max(habit, streak(it.check)), "best streak"
heat last 70 days, count(check on it), n
form habit
describe:
Habits Plus, in the mint colours.
Keeps:
- habit: name: text. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
- check: habit: a habit. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
Works out:
- n is how many habit entries.
Shows:
- text: how many check entries today, "of", n, "done today".
- if n is 0:
  - text: "Nothing to track yet. Add one.".
- for each habit:
  - a group; a tap opens the habit for editing; a swipe removes the habit, with undo:
    - text: its name.
    - text: the current day streak of its check entries, "day streak,", how many its check entries in the last 30 days times 100 divided by 30 rounded, "% in 30 days".
    - a tick box for its check.
- a big number: how many check entries this week times 100 divided by the result of n times the weekday number of today rounded, labelled "% this week".
- a big number: how many check entries in the last 30 days times 100 divided by the result of n times 30 rounded, labelled "% in 30 days".
- a big number: the highest of the current day streak of its check entries over the habit, labelled "best streak".
- a heat map of how many check entries on that day for each day in the last 70 days.
- a form to add a habit.

program:
app "Dhaba" food ink
table dish name text, price money, ready bool = yes
table order dish ref dish, qty num 1..20 = 1
screen menu "Menu" food
  each dish sort name as d
    row card gap 2 tap edit d
      stack grow
        d.name bold
        d.price faint
      toggle d.ready
  form dish, "Add dish"
screen orders "Orders" list
  "Today's sale" sum(order today, it.qty * it.dish.price) big
  each dish where ready = yes sort name as d
    row card gap 2
      d.name grow
      count(d.order today) "sold" faint
      button "+1" tap add order dish = d
